name: Wren
tagline: A clear round timer for training days that need rhythm, not clutter.
shortDescription: A native iOS round timer for boxing, MMA, and grappling, with clear presets and audio cues.
longDescription: Wren focuses on training flow: warm-up, rounds, rest, and cooldown. It is a dependable round timer first, with recovery features planned carefully rather than rushed in.
featureIntro: Set the shape of the session, put the phone down, and let the timer do its job.

features.title: Round Timer
features.body: Warm-up, rounds, rest, and cooldown with a large countdown made for quick glances.

features.title: Discipline Presets
features.body: Profiles for MMA, boxing, and grappling with configurable rounds, rest, and warnings.

features.title: Audio Cues
features.body: Start, end, and warning sounds that are easy to understand mid-session.

features.title: Session Logs
features.body: Optional local logs for people who want a simple record of training.

structuredData.description: A native iOS round timer for boxing, MMA, and grappling, with clear presets and audio cues.
featureList: Round timer for warm-up, rounds, rest, and cooldown

privacySummary: Wren's MVP stores optional session logs locally. Future HealthKit features will require explicit permission.
